name: U23-3-expanded-2-200
steps: const nav=document.querySelector('.nav').getBoundingClientRect();const open=[...document.querySelectorAll('.safety-rail__target button')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Open control');if(!open||open.getBoundingClientRect().bottom>nav.top)throw Error('Open control covered by tabs');const stops=[...document.querySelectorAll('.safety-rail .named-stop__button')];for(const stop of stops){stop.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});const r=stop.getBoundingClientRect();const hit=document.elementFromPoint(r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2);if(!hit||!stop.contains(hit))throw Error('Stop unreachable');}open.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});
